facts.fact: The Bowmans analysis says Kenya's private member's AI Bill, before the Senate, would require labelling of AI-generated synthetic media, criminalise harmful non-consensual synthetic media and set up an Office of the Artificial Intelligence Commissioner.

facts.fact: The Bowmans analysis says the AI Bill formally remains before the Senate, though the Senate ICT committee recommended in October 2026 not to proceed until a national AI policy is finalised.

facts.fact: The Ministry of Information, Communications and the Digital Economy launched the National Artificial Intelligence Strategy 2025-2030 in March 2025, per the Bowmans analysis.
Cabinet established a Standing Cabinet Committee on Artificial Intelligence in June 2026 to steer implementation of the National AI Strategy, per the Bowmans analysis.
